claims.claim_text: A coupled affine command model improves held-out velocity prediction on the supplied passive Go2 dataset.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not generalize beyond the same-day single-robot passive dataset.

claims.claim_text: Task-weighted active design reaches frozen synthetic targets in fewer trials than registered passive, D-optimal, and no-task controls.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not describe synthetic sample efficiency as demonstrated hardware efficiency.

claims.claim_text: The independent hard filter and validation-based stopping rule satisfy registered replay and fault-injection gates.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not describe replay safety as deployment certification.

claims.claim_text: Twelve-trial active calibration reduces held-out velocity RMSE in four fixed-configuration Isaac Lab scenarios.
Full active recovery improves early post-shift RMSE over passive updating under four registered simulator shifts.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not claim terminal superiority over passive updating.

claims.claim_text: Held-out simulator evaluation supports GAUGE navigation gains over raw control and noninferiority to a dense reference on registered endpoints.

negative_constraints.rule: Present only the frozen final protocol and its evidence; do not narrate development chronology or failed iterations.

manifest_negative_constraints.rule: Online active calibration and shift recovery are not yet quantitatively established on physical hardware.
No real-world deployment, arbitrary-shift, or sim-to-real claim.
No absolute first or only novelty claim.
